instrument: Reading zoning amendment limiting data centers to manufacturing districts
summary: Draft amendment would limit data centers to the Heavy Manufacturing and Manufacturing Commercial districts. The city's 180-day curative-amendment moratorium expires in January if the ordinance is not adopted first.

source.citation: Strisker Data Centers Weekly Briefing, Sept 21-24, 2026 (digest), citing local reporting (WFMZ)

next.event: Reading Planning Commission possible vote on data center zoning amendment
